title: Sr. Talent Acquisition Executive
description:
2Base Technologies is a custom software development company with over 16 years of delivery experience. We work as an enterprise solutions partner for clients in the United Kingdom, the United States, India and other markets, building web and mobile applications and end-to-end digital solutions across industries.

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Executive to join our People & Culture team and take ownership of our end-to-end hiring function.

This role is for someone who enjoys finding the right people, building talent pipelines, influencing candidates and closing positions, not simply forwarding CVs.

**What You’ll Own**

* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle from understanding the requirement to candidate joining and onboarding follow-up.
* Work closely with hiring managers to understand the role, define the right candidate profile and establish hiring timelines.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Foundit, Indeed, referrals, networking and direct outreach.
* Take ownership of active and passive candidate sourcing, especially for difficult-to-fill technology and senior positions.
* Conduct initial screening and evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, motivation, compensation, availability, and cultural fit.
* Manage multiple open positions simultaneously while maintaining clear priorities and timelines.
* Coordinate interviews and ensure a smooth candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
* Own offer discussions, negotiation, and candidate closure while working within approved compensation bands.
* Maintain accurate and timely recruitment data in Zoho Recruit, including candidate stages, feedback, interview status, and closure details.
* Build and maintain strong talent pools for recurring and future hiring requirements.
* Track recruitment performance through metrics such as time-to-hire, source effectiveness, stage conversion, offer acceptance, and joining ratio.
* Provide regular hiring updates and insights to hiring managers and the People & Culture leadership.
* Stay updated on talent-market trends, salary benchmarks, competitor hiring, and availability of key technology skills.
* Explore and implement new sourcing methods, recruitment technology, and AI-assisted hiring tools that improve speed and quality.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in IT recruitment, preferably in a software services or product company.
* Proven experience hiring for technical and non-technical positions, particularly engineering and technology roles.
* Strong hands-on sourcing skills across LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Foundit, Indeed, Boolean search, X-ray search, referrals, and direct sourcing.
* Ability to understand technical job requirements and assess whether a candidate’s experience genuinely matches the role.
* Strong candidate engagement and negotiation skills, particularly during offer and closure stages.
* Experience managing multiple positions and competing hiring priorities independently.
* Hands-on experience with an ATS or Recruitment Management System; experience with Zoho Recruit is an advantage.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills with the confidence to interact with candidates at all levels.
* Strong ownership, follow-through, and accountability. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for a role from requirement to joining.
* Data-driven approach to recruitment, with the ability to identify what is working and what needs to change.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change, and hiring requirements can be urgent.
* Based in Kochi or willing to relocate to Kochi.
* Willing to work on-site at our Infopark office, five days a week.

**It’s a Plus If You Have**

* Experience building long-term talent pools or candidate communities.
* Experience hiring for Tech and non-Technical positions.
* Experience conducting walk-in drives, campus hiring, or large-scale recruitment campaigns.
* Experience creating or improving recruitment processes, SOPs, or hiring playbooks.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve sourcing, screening, or recruitment productivity.

**Why This Role at 2Base?**

* Real ownership: You will own hiring, not just one part of the recruitment process.
* Direct exposure: Work closely with the People & Culture leadership, hiring managers, and business leadership.
* Variety of hiring: From freshers to senior technology professionals across Engineering, Product, Marketing, Design and Operations.
* Build the function: You will have the opportunity to improve our sourcing strategy, processes, candidate pipelines and recruitment technology.
* Use AI meaningfully: Explore practical ways to use AI and automation to make recruitment faster and more effective.
* Grow beyond recruitment: You will work closely with the wider People & Culture function and gain exposure to people operations, performance, capability building and employee engagement.

**If You Are Someone Who**

finds people others can’t, builds relationships that last, takes ownership of every position, and enjoys turning a difficult requirement into a successful hire, we’d like to meet you.

### Job Description
  
  
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented \*\*Junior US IT Recruiter\*\* to support our global IT Field Services projects.
  
The primary responsibility will be sourcing, screening, and coordinating IT professionals and field engineers for US and European projects. This is a hands-on junior-level role suited for candidates with basic US IT recruitment experience who are eager to grow in international IT staffing and resource coordination.

### Preferred - Exposure to US-based candidates, IT contractors, or staffing vendors. - Basic understanding of recruitment trackers, onboarding, and resource coordination. - Familiarity with ATS or CRM tools.
  
  
### Important – Role Level \*\*This is strictly a Junior / Individual Contributor position.\*\* - Suitable for candidates with 1–2 years of hands-on recruitment experience. - Candidates should be comfortable with sourcing, screening, calling, follow-ups, and recruitment coordination. - This is an execution-focused role, not a team lead, managerial, or recruitment strategy position. - Candidates seeking senior-level or managerial responsibilities are not the target for this opening.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**About Delight Investment Group**

Delight Investment Group (DIG) is a diversified global investment holding company headquartered in Abu Dhabi, UAE, with a presence at Hub71 on Al Maryah Island. Established in 1989, DIG manages a portfolio of businesses across relocation, facilities management, security services, cleaning, logistics, freight forwarding and investment management. Our subsidiaries serve clients across the UAE, GCC, UK, India and other international markets. We operate with a people-centred, value-based approach, focused on strategic investment management, long-term wealth preservation and operational excellence. Through initiatives such as the Delight Foundation, we are committed to community impact, resilience, integrity and sustainable growth.

**About DTech IT and Outsourcing, Kochi**

DTech IT and Outsourcing is the group’s IT and outsourcing division, with its India operations based in Kochi. It delivers technology and business support services that power the group’s operations across multiple sectors and markets. As the group grows, DTech is building a strong talent acquisition function in Kochi to attract skilled people for the Kochi hub and the wider group.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage end-to-end recruitment across the group’s businesses. You will partner with hiring managers to understand workforce needs, define role requirements and build effective recruitment strategies. You will hire for both
**white collar**
and
**blue collar**
positions, from IT, corporate and back-office roles to facilities, cleaning, security, logistics and field operations roles.

* Manage the full recruitment life cycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating hiring activities, offers and onboarding.
* Recruit for

  **blue collar roles**

* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and recruitment strategies.
* Post job advertisements and maintain active talent pipelines.
* Conduct candidate assessments and support selection decisions.
* Handle multiple requisitions and priorities at the same time.
* Deliver a positive candidate experience from first contact through onboarding.
* Support employer branding initiatives to promote DIG as an attractive place to work.
* Maintain accurate recruitment data and reports.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies and relevant employment regulations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business or a related field; professional HR or recruiting certifications are an advantage.
* Relevant experience in talent acquisition or human resources, preferably in diversified or service-oriented organisations.
* Strong full-life-cycle recruiting skills.
* Solid interviewing and hiring skills to assess candidates and support selection decisions.
* Employer branding capability.
* Experience or willingness to handle both white collar and blue collar hiring.
* Strong communication, relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with recruitment tools and HR systems, with attention to data accuracy and confidentiality.

* Work across diverse industries and international markets.
* Grow within a people-centred culture built on integrity and long-term development

**People Operations Admin** 





 Recruitment  •  People Operations  •  Administration  •  Global Team Support
 




**About Resonate** 





 Resonate is an Australian customer experience (CX) software company. For a decade, we’ve helped organisations listen to their customers and act on what they hear. Today, we work across global markets, supported by a team spanning Australia, India, the Philippines, the UK and the US.
 





 We’re at an exciting point in our journey — growing, investing in our product, and building the kind of company people are proud to be part of. This is a brand\-new role, created to help us do exactly that.
 




**The Role** 





 As our People Operations Admin, you’ll play an important role in keeping our People Operations running smoothly and helping create a great employee experience across Resonate.
 





 This is a hands\-on role covering recruitment, people administration, onboarding, employee experience, culture initiatives and day\-to\-day People \& Culture support. You’ll work closely with the People \& Culture team, managers and employees across our global locations.
 




**What You’ll Do** 




**Recruitment** 



* Support recruitment activities including job postings, candidate screening, interview coordination and candidate communication.



**People Operations \& Administration** 



* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems and documentation.
* Support day\-to\-day People \& Culture administration, reporting and employee lifecycle processes.
* Coordinate onboarding from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, including introductions, systems access and resources.



**People \& Culture Initiatives** 



* Support employee engagement, recognition, surveys, culture initiatives and internal People \& Culture communications.
* Help coordinate company events, team activities and employee programs.



**Global Team Support** 



* Support employees across Australia, India, the Philippines, the UK and the US.
* Coordinate activities across locations and time zones and work with local providers and partners.
* Help create connection, consistency and a positive employee experience across our distributed teams.



  





**About You** 





 You’re organised, approachable and genuinely enjoy helping people. You don’t need to know everything about HR — what matters most is that you’re curious, proactive and eager to learn.
 



* 1–3 years’ experience in HR, People \& Culture, People Operations, administration, recruitment or a similar role.
* Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive approach, good problem\-solving skills and willingness to take ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Experience using HR systems and Microsoft Office/365\.
* Ability to work confidently with AI tools and an interest in smarter ways of working.
* Basic graphic design skills.
* Event planning or coordination experience is a nice\-to\-have.
* Experience working with distributed or global teams is an advantage.



**What We Offer** 



* Broad exposure to People \& Culture and the opportunity to build your HR career.
* Real ownership and the opportunity to make an impact from day one.
* Exposure to leaders and teams across a growing global business.
* Learning and development opportunities.
* A supportive and collaborative team environment.
* The opportunity to grow with Resonate as the business continues to evolve.
* Opportunities to travel and experience different parts of the world.



**Why Resonate?** 





 At Resonate, we believe great customer experiences start with great employee experiences. We’re a growing, global team that values collaboration, curiosity, ownership and having a bit of fun along the way.
 





 If you’re looking for a role where you can learn, contribute and make a real difference to the employee experience, we’d love to hear from you.
 




**How to Apply** 





 If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and tell us a little about yourself and why you’d be a great addition to the Resonate team.
